verdict.rationale: OpenAI's speech-to-text docs describe uploading a completed recording to get a final transcript returned as JSON. They show a file-upload command (`audio:transcriptions create --file /path/to/file/audio.mp3`) and publish a 25 MB size limit plus accepted formats, including the video containers mp4 and webm. missing for 10: an explicit raw HTTP endpoint path and request schema in the cited excerpts (no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API file uploads.
